text: **Eight substantial findings accepted; two remain.** [R014](findings/R014-uniform-coefficient-extraction.md) passes both independent gates and parent reproduction. [C66’s original proof passes](reviews/i67-logarithmic-blowup-r2.md), but [I68](reviews/i68-logarithmic-blowup-novelty.md) classifies it as technical only; its exactly explained parent-wrapper hash failures remain preserved. [I71](iterations/i71-global-variation-algebra-rounding.md) gives a linked strict-local-maximum obstruction and a cap-preserving spectral stopping certificate, with parent evidence PASS. AR remains unproved and unrefuted; further work needs a new global selection/stopping mechanism. [I70](iterations/i70-symplectic-geometry-discovery.md) leaves arbitrary-prefix relative ball packing unproved and unrefuted; its small-ball complement partial has fixed volume slack and is technical only. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I73](iterations/i73-arithmetic-geometry-discovery.md) records two incomplete constructions for minimal rank in polynomial twists, with parent provenance and finite-interface PASS; no substantial result is nominated. [I75](iterations/i75-polynomial-twist-selmer.md) independently audits the used prerequisites and gives a forced finite Selmer class, a one-level local-relaxation bound, the Gaussian restriction pairing loss, and actual rank-zero and sparse positive-rank twists. Parent reproduction passes; density and mean targets remain open and the branch is parked. [I72](iterations/i72-graph-probability-discovery.md) pays finite-switch symmetry and the entropy cost of rare girth conditioning but leaves the conditional spectral input open; its percolation extension is technical only. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I76](iterations/i76-logarithmic-girth-spectra.md) proves clean and fixed-positive-disorder spectra universality under logarithmic-girth conditioning and the stipulated premises. The clean proof uses rejection absorption and a weaker spectral interface with a log-determinant replacement for full rigidity. [I78](reviews/i78-logarithmic-girth-spectra-r2.md) passes both original proofs without substantive repairs; parent reproduction passes. [I79](reviews/i79-logarithmic-girth-spectra-novelty-r3.md) classifies A, B and the package as technical, with a concrete reduction to existing lower proof operations. Parent reproduction passes; the proof-verified spectral extension does not enter the substantial count. [I74](iterations/i74-relative-symplectic-packing.md) independently passes the used I70 arguments and constructs restricted transport and protected comparison models, with parent evidence PASS. Arbitrary relative packing remains open and is parked pending an adapted global construction. [I77](iterations/i77-weighted-switch-mixing.md) pays weighted pair-slice comparison and a complete matching-subclass flow, while two actual local counterexamples block unchanged weighted source estimates. Parent reproduction passes. The all-degree target is unproved and unrefuted, and parked pending a new aggregate or encoding argument. [I80](iterations/i80-geometric-flows-computation-discovery.md) proposes C80: compact velocity, pressure and solenoidal forcing with rapid decay and exact particle computation on fixed Euclidean space. [I85](reviews/i85-compact-solenoidal-computation-r2.md) passes the original proof without repairs, including all-degree pressure cancellation, small-angle gates, loading, global derivative/support budgets and effective evaluation. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I86](reviews/i86-compact-solenoidal-computation-novelty-r3.md) completes the strongest relevant fluid-companion comparison and classifies C80 as TECHNICAL through a complete effective moving compact-Euler-template reduction. I85 resolves the original-proof condition; no finding is added. Parent reproduction preserves the frozen verifier’s inventory-order failure and passes its separate read-only ordering correction with all sealed bytes unchanged. The equivariant geometric and sharp cap-scale targets remain unresolved. [I81](iterations/i81-diophantine-approximation-discovery.md) completes a Diophantine gap report with author-level technical Catalan bounds and parent evidence PASS; finite irrationality measure remains unproved and unrefuted. [I83](iterations/i83-catalan-finite-measure.md) passes original I81 A/B and its conditional criterion without repairs. Its actual integer forms still lack bounded-block noncoincidence; the specified hypergeometric clearing grows at every fixed parameter, while a sufficient gcd saving remains unproved. Parent evidence reproduction passes. C81 is unproved and unrefuted, and parked pending a new mechanism. [I82](iterations/i82-measured-group-operator-discovery.md) gives an author-level polynomial finite-row trace-randomization theorem, classified technical, and precise ergodic-cost and abstract-isomorphism gaps. Parent evidence reproduction passes; no independent analytic verdict is claimed. [I84](iterations/i84-abstract-close-algebras.md) passes the original I82 sequence-algebra criterion without repairs and gives an author proof of abstract nonisomorphism for all positive source parameters. Its characteristic essential ideal and trace representation make arbitrary automorphisms spatial after fixed amplification, preserving the original tensor obstruction. [I87](reviews/i87-abstract-close-algebras-r2.md) passes the original A84 proof for every 0<t<1, both general lemmas and the reused coordinate criterion without repairs, and confirms the technical disposition. Parent evidence reproduction passes; the separate CSSWW passage-locator correction is retained without changing original artifacts. [I88](iterations/i88-nonlinear-banach-discovery.md) gives an exponential coordinate-support bound, qualitative rank divergence and an actual rank-one sparsification obstruction, all author-level technical partials. Parent evidence reproduction passes. Quantitative rank and the coupled absorption/AP construction remain unproved and unrefuted; the finite binary diamond strengthening is rejected by primary literature. [I90](iterations/i90-anchored-rank-approximation.md) passes original I88 A/A′/B without repairs and gives an author proof of an exponential rank bound on the actual finite metric truncations. Weighted pairwise continuation, classical finite-dimensional domination and clipping before local-type transfer replace coordinate-support counting. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I92](reviews/i92-anchored-rank-approximation-r2.md) passes the original Q90 proof, W/E/C and all quantitative variants without repairs, with parent evidence reproduction passing. [I93](reviews/i93-anchored-rank-approximation-novelty-r3.md) classifies the full package as technical via source state-indexed operations, classical Auerbach domination and bounded TV comparison. Parent evidence reproduction passes and I92 resolves its original-proof condition. No count increment. [I94](iterations/i94-topology-transformation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical nonextension and even-tail stabilization results, with parent evidence replay passing. The free involution on the actual marked V#2(S²×S²) remains unproved and unrefuted. [I97](iterations/i97-relative-involution-stabilization.md) passes original A/B without repairs, rules out a geometrically split residual free orbit at count two, and records integral-form and cut-defect constraints as author-level technical partials. Parent evidence replay passes; R94 remains unproved and unrefuted. [I100](iterations/i100-defect-tolerant-topology-obstruction.md) passes original C/D/E and the scoped complement/Whitney claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new technical residual presentation and periodic localization do not improve the stabilization bound, and an exact algebraic counterexample blocks rank-only tensor extensions. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted; the branch is parked pending new geometric control. [I103](iterations/i103-algebraic-complexity-discovery.md) gives complete author-level positive-characteristic rational hitting lists and an every-field 9/4 matrix-multiplication exponent transfer, both classified technical by its concrete source-operation comparison. [I106](iterations/i106-positive-characteristic-imm.md) passes all original constructions and scoped counterexamples without repairs and independently confirms the technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. [I109](iterations/i109-modular-imm-rank.md) passes all original I106 partials and scoped obstructions without repairs and confirms their technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible periodic minors and exact excursion-rank decomposition remain too small for the circuit target. The full excursion degeneration has exponentially deficient rank in characteristic two; this is not an upper bound on full IMM rank. The all-prime target remains unproved and unrefuted, and this construction branch is parked. [I112](iterations/iteration112-inverse-boundary-discovery-task.json) begins fresh inverse-boundary research. [I89](iterations/i89-geometric-group-discovery.md) gives technical proximal-contraction and finite-residual witness deductions; parent evidence reproduction passes. Its used contraction prerequisites pass I91 without repairs; R89 remains outside that independent audit. [I91](iterations/i91-finite-cat0-obstruction.md) passes the used I89 prerequisites without repairs and gives an author proof of explicit finite CAT(0) energy-contraction constants, using fixed-scale midpoint estimates and a retained rational certificate. Parent evidence and exact certificate replays pass. [I95](reviews/i95-finite-cat0-obstruction-r2.md) passes the original Q91 proof and action-to-certificate implication without repairs; parent evidence and independent reconstruction pass. [I96](reviews/i96-finite-cat0-obstruction-novelty-r3.md) classifies the full Q91 theorem as technical through a complete source-operation reduction and a 12-point scalar contradiction; parent evidence replay passes and I95 resolves its proof condition. [I98](iterations/i98-complex-kahler-discovery.md) records author-level technical finite-radius and relative complete-spray constructions, with parent evidence replay passing. The arbitrary K3-family Oka-map target remains unproved and unrefuted; [I102](iterations/i102-relative-k3-oka-construction.md) passes original A98/W98 and both method obstructions without repairs, at the precise reduced-space interpolation scope. Parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible whole-central-slice germ, conditional relative sewing and adaptive exhaustion criterion remain technical; the fixed-domain extension is missing and R98 is parked unproved and unrefuted. [I104](iterations/i104-modular-representation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical equivariant subsection/trace identities, an all-length A5 divisibility estimate, and explicit obstructions to forgetting Frobenius descent data. Parent evidence replay passes; the blockwise Galois Alperin weight target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I108](iterations/i108-galois-tuple-divisibility.md) passes all original I104 claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. [I110](iterations/i110-galois-moment-cancellation.md) passes the original finite-moment criterion and constrained-puncture/index claims without repairs; parent replay passes. New exact fixed-label reconstruction, 56 finite moment certificates, a uniform A5×A divisibility bound for odd-order abelian A, and equivariant nontrivial local-point pairing are technical partials. Arbitrary admissible cancellation and G104 remain unproved/unrefuted; the trivial local-point component is unpaid and the branch is parked. [I114](iterations/iteration114-quantum-information-discovery-task.json) begins fresh quantum-information research. [I99](iterations/i99-quantitative-arithmetic-patterns-discovery.md) gives author-level joint-kernel estimates, sharp transfer obstructions and a coefficient-explicit counting bridge; parent evidence replay passes. Its uniform nonlinear Roth target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I101](iterations/i101-two-scale-nonlinear-roth.md) passes original A1–A5/B1–B4 and the scoped counterexamples without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its short-window graph bounds, actual parabolic matrix comparison and block-conditioned counts remain technical. C99 is parked unproved and unrefuted pending the precise deterministic block comparison (U). [I107](iterations/i107-rational-tail-attachment.md) passes all original [I105](iterations/i105-chromatic-homotopy-discovery.md) claims without repairs and supplies an author-level full proof of R105: the actual rational tail splits under F4 and over V for every p≥5 and allowed choice, retaining the nonzero middle attachment. Parent evidence replay passes. [I111](reviews/i111-rational-tail-attachment-r2.md) passes every component of the original full proof without repairs, including the uniform limit, actual detector injection and under/over compatibility, and independently confirms its technical disposition. Parent evidence replay passes; R105 is technically closed under the stipulated premises and no finding is added. [I113](iterations/iteration113-online-optimization-discovery-task.json) begins fresh online optimization and stochastic-games discovery. No literal presentation or size/runtime bound is claimed. No ninth finding is accepted.

**Resumed on 2026-10-09: [10-finding ledger](TEN-FINDINGS.md); 7 accepted, 3 remaining.** The user requested continuation to ten and project-only public publication after verification. Each candidate needs a complete new bridge and separate proof and significance reviews before it enters the count. I14 is now technical only. [I15 ternary topology](iterations/i15-odd-order-topology-resumed.md) retains proof PASS but is **technical only** after [final significance review](reviews/i15-odd-order-topology-novelty-r3.md): repeated marked-annulus replacement is already available in the source proof. [I17 six-point spherical Ramsey](iterations/i17-fresh-discovery.md) retains full proof PASS but is **technical only** after [final significance review](reviews/i17-six-point-ramsey-novelty-r3.md): two elementary adjugate lifts and their product supply the certificate. No exact duplicate or new gap is claimed. [I18](iterations/i18-joint-prime-neighbors.md) is a verified gap record with no count increment. [I19](iterations/i19-fresh-structural-discovery.md) supplies a technical signed Saxl quotient with a precise remaining gap; [I21](iterations/i21-signed-saxl-dominance.md) constructs signed maps but finds a required constituent missing and proves fixed-width limits. That route is parked; [I24 completes its resumed investigation](iterations/i24-elementary-unimodality-resumed.md): relevant history jumps are finite and centered, but the character-positivity and Lefschetz gaps remain. [I20](iterations/i20-pde-kinetic-discovery.md) records kinetic selection and fluctuation gaps with verified technical initial-law deductions; [I23](iterations/i23-kinetic-connected-fluctuations.md) develops component bounds but leaves normalized signed-history summation unresolved; [I26](iterations/i26-probability-discovery-resumed.md) completes a three-target probability screen but leaves the integer-height interface limit unproved; [I22](iterations/i22-combinatorial-discovery.md) records technical entropy/prophet deductions and unresolved general targets. [I25 is accepted as R011](findings/R011-rooted-matching-entropy.md), the fifth substantial finding: the rooted coefficient-3/2 theorem passes independent full-proof and significance reviews plus parent verification.

**Fourth substantial deduction accepted:** [R010](findings/R010-complex-modes-PD-independence.md) proves joint uniformity of Omega(p-1) modulo every fixed m and independence from the PD(1) ranked-factor law in fixed reduced progressions. Both independent reviews pass, and parent checks reproduce. The common nonzero principal model and its signed recombination supply the additional argument beyond parity. The pause at four ended with the user's explicit resumption on 2026-10-09; the ten-finding target remains incomplete.

**Third substantial deduction accepted:** [R009](findings/R009-variable-channel-capacity.md) proves the variable-channel four-state weighted-capacity criterion, including locally finite trees and universal information bounds. Proof, significance and extension audits pass; parent checks reproduce. This is one finding, including all degree and zero-edge extensions.

**Second substantial deduction accepted:** [Iteration 05](iterations/README.md#iteration-05--second-substantial-result-accepted) meets the user's request for another result after R006 through R008, on the stipulated-corpus and bounded novelty basis. The simultaneous-root lane made [partial scalar progress](iterations/i06-cubic-reservoir.md), but its explicit rough-correlation estimate and cubic reservoir remain unproved; that lane is parked at the stated gap.

The [parity result R008](findings/R008-parity-PD-independence.md) gives full Liouville cancellation jointly with PD(1) and squarefreeness in every fixed reduced progression. Independent analytic and final significance reviews support acceptance, and parent checks reproduce. It implies Moree–Hommersom Conjecture 1 with finitely prescribed valuations. The final record includes current-version prior-art corrections and retains the limit that worldwide priority is unverified.

**The continued iterations reached a substantial result under the accepted-corpus premise.** The [iteration record](iterations/README.md) documents the search and acceptance decision. The [first-pass outcome](OUTCOME.md) records the previous unsuccessful search and remains historical. [R006](findings/R006-progression-PD-primitive-root-density.md) now has a complete, independently reviewed deduction of positive-proportion primitive roots for every admissible fixed base under the accepted corpus. The final review supports the substantive/nonroutine gate. Worldwide priority and the exact Artin density formula remain unproved. Working reports are provisional until reviewed and integrated. The immutable source revision is recorded in [../sources/upstream.json](../sources/upstream.json).

[R004 — Simultaneous bounded residual index](findings/R004-simultaneous-bounded-index.md) combines two accepted corpus inputs to put every base in a fixed finite set at bounded index for a positive proportion of primes. The corrected theorem and prime-average corollary pass independent proof review; parent finite checks and source hashes reproduce. The literature screen found no exact duplicate, but a nonroutine new mechanism and priority remain unproved for this finding. The subsequent progression work has now produced the stronger single-base result R006 below.

[R006](findings/R006-progression-PD-primitive-root-density.md) proves PD(1) for the ranked prime factors of `p−1` in every fixed reduced progression. Combining this with the accepted all-prime-index splitting bounds gives a positive proportion of primitive-root primes for every integer `|a|≥2` that is not a positive square, uniformly over every sufficiently large dyadic interval for that base. This improves the accepted count from order `x/log²x` to `x/log x`, with index exactly one. The two-endpoint residue construction supplies joint information unavailable from marginal PD alone.

The [full proof](iterations/i03-arithmetic-progressions.md) passes [independent analytic review](reviews/i03-arithmetic-progressions-r4.md); parent exact checks and source verification reproduce. It does not prove existence of natural density or Artin's exact constant. The [final novelty/significance review](reviews/i03-arithmetic-novelty-r5.md) supports a substantial, nonroutine improvement and found no established duplicate under the available premises. The parent accepts the research target on that qualified basis. Worldwide priority remains unverified. R006 records the stronger-corpus checks, older zero-free-region comparison, overlapping public claim and MathDB retrieval clarification.

[I36 common geometric avoidance](iterations/i36-harmonic-analysis-discovery.md) retains [independent full-proof PASS without repairs](reviews/i36-common-geometric-avoidance-r2.md), but its [final significance review](reviews/i36-common-geometric-avoidance-novelty-r3.md) judges it **technical only**: G/D routing and prior moving-window/multidimensional partition operations supply the added step. No exact theorem duplicate or new proof gap is claimed. [I37](iterations/i37-supergeometric-avoidance.md) completes a developed gap report for 2^(-n²), with a scoped fair-routing obstruction and unpaid digital covering and conditional-survivor criteria. Parent reproduction passes; the avoidance target remains unproved and not refuted. That route is parked pending a new mechanism. Accepted count remains five of ten.

**Sixth substantial finding accepted: [R012 — uniform Gaussian propeller stability](findings/R012-uniform-gaussian-propeller-stability.md).** I38 retains [original-proof PASS without repairs](reviews/i38-propeller-stability-r2.md), and its [final significance review](reviews/i38-propeller-stability-novelty-r3.md) recommends SUBSTANTIAL. The quadratic first-moment deficit bound has one constant independent of dimension and finite cell count, and a sharp distance exponent of 1/2. The new contribution controls arbitrarily many disappearing labels through compactification and a cubic aggregate activation estimate. Parent reproduction passes with all 274 monitored author/reviewer files unchanged. Worldwide priority remains uncertified. At that checkpoint, six findings were accepted.

[I39 quantum/spectral research](iterations/i39-quantum-spectral-discovery.md) is a completed gap report: uniform weak-disorder Haldane stability remains unproved and not refuted after two approaches. Its exact method obstructions do not refute that target. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I41](iterations/i41-rademacher-fair-start-warming.md) independently passes I40’s technical Gaussian all-initial-law relaxation deduction without repairs. Its technical four-time profile comparison and supporting partial results pass [I42’s independent audit](reviews/i42-four-time-profile-r2.md) without repairs. Parent reproduction passes, with the direct I41 ledger-drift failure and the separate frozen-ledger replay explicitly recorded. The normalized fair-start density representation and entropy countermodel identify the remaining gap; full two-law relaxation remains unproved and unrefuted. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I43](iterations/i43-convex-isoperimetric-discovery.md) records three completed screens and two approaches to logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski equality, with exact partial results but no completed target. Parent evidence checks pass. [I44](iterations/i44-logarithmic-equality-polytopes.md) passes the original I43 partials and develops new facet/boundary deductions, an attributed symmetric equality argument and a planar cubic obstruction to quadratic stability. [I45](reviews/i45-logarithmic-equality-r2.md) passes all four original claims without repairs, checking the symmetric equality argument rather than assuming the external proposed theorem. Parent reproduction passes. Symmetric E is technically closed with full attribution; [I46](iterations/i46-quantitative-logarithmic-stability.md) supplies a uniform planar exponent-10 estimate for arbitrary symmetric bodies, with no facet restriction. [I47](reviews/i47-planar-logarithmic-stability-r2.md) passes the original proof without repairs; [I48](reviews/i48-planar-logarithmic-stability-novelty.md) judges it **TECHNICAL ONLY**, with an explicit weighted dual-Cheeger and geometric reduction preserving the full planar scope. Parent reproduction passes; no exact duplicate is claimed. [R013](findings/R013-higher-dimensional-logarithmic-stability.md) is now accepted as the seventh substantial finding. [I50](reviews/i50-hard-moment-quantitative-stability-r2.md) passes I49’s original unrestricted finite-power proof without repairs, including its dimension-only exponent. [I51](reviews/i51-hard-moment-quantitative-stability-novelty.md) judges the integrated finite-defect construction substantial; I50 satisfies its proof condition. Parent reproduction passes, with the initial I49 search-order failure and the separately normalized replay preserved. **Seven accepted, three remaining.** [I52](iterations/i52-ergodic-dynamical-discovery.md) is a completed gap report: relative entropy asymptotics, finite-time bounds and a conditional projective route are technical partial results; the constant additive-loss target was left open there. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I54](iterations/i54-standard-map-additive-entropy.md) now proposes a complete additive-loss proof using a quantitative initial scale and the pinned limiting contradiction, plus restricted projective nonconcentration. [I57](reviews/i57-standard-map-additive-entropy-r2.md) passes the original additive-entropy proof, selected-scale extension and restricted projective estimates without repairs. Parent reproduction passes, preserving I52’s historical search failure caused by twelve later I54 matches. [I58](reviews/i58-standard-map-additive-entropy-novelty.md) judges H and G **TECHNICAL ONLY**, with explicit reductions to the inherited contradiction and graph machinery. Parent reproduction passes. The standard-map route is technically closed without a substantial-count increment. Meanwhile [I55](reviews/i55-sharp-entropy-stability-r2.md) passes [I53’s](iterations/i53-sharp-entropy-stability-discovery.md) original fixed-dimensional Wasserstein proof without repairs. [I56](reviews/i56-sharp-entropy-stability-novelty.md) judges it **TECHNICAL ONLY**, giving a complete transverse-derivative reduction with the same exponent and unrestricted scope. Parent reproduction passes for both. Numerical quadrature values remain approximations, not certified upper bounds. H53 is technically closed but does not increase the substantial count. [I59](iterations/i59-dimension-uniform-entropy-stability.md) completes a gap report with averaged normalization/compatibility estimates, an orthant-radial test-class theorem and two explicit method obstructions. The dimension-uniform target remains unproved and unrefuted; parent evidence reproduction passes, without an independent analytic verdict. [I61](iterations/i61-averaged-entropy-coefficient-rounding.md) independently passes the stated I59 inputs and proposes CE61, a dimension-independent logarithmic coefficient estimate under a fixed operator-energy cap, with a paid symmetric-tensor repair. Parent evidence replay passes. [I63](reviews/i63-entropy-coefficient-extraction-r2.md) passes the original CE61 proof, symmetric repair, conditional propagation and scoped partial results without repairs. Parent reproduction passes, including 33,917 independent exact assertions. [I64](reviews/i64-entropy-coefficient-extraction-novelty.md) judges the uniform coefficient bridge **SUBSTANTIAL**, with the technical repair included once. Parent reproduction passes. [R014](findings/R014-uniform-coefficient-extraction.md) is accepted as the eighth substantial finding. Algebra rounding and the general entropy target remain unproved and unrefuted. **Eight accepted, two remaining.** [I60](iterations/i60-threshold-structural-combinatorics-discovery.md) records a complete technical cube-to-slice transfer, scoped counterexamples to three stronger claims, inherited Hall slack and an unresolved same-density two-union integral-cover target. Parent evidence and PDF replay checks pass; no independent analytic verdict or substantial nomination is claimed. [I62](iterations/i62-same-density-two-union-covers.md) completes technical bounded-rank and graph covers and proves method obstructions using actual high-probability downsets. The general two-union target remains unproved and unrefuted. Parent evidence and eight PDF replays pass; no substantial nomination or independent analytic PASS is claimed.
